exact reproduction of v1 GT, hazy, and combined aggregate file SHA-256 identities
PNG format, RGB mode, and positive width-height metadata for all 550 exact files
nonnegative, even, positive, and at-most-32-pixels-per-side crop constraints
zero model, checkpoint, training, inference, restoration metric, image display, pixel comparison, and protected-data operations

image display or human visual inspection
scientific model-quality, promotion, or deployment conclusion

the current registered asset exactly reproduces the v1 root, direct PNG counts, filename mapping, and three aggregate SHA-256 identities
all 50 clear scenes and all 500 paired hazy variants form one positive, even, nonnegative clear-minus-hazy delta with at most 32 pixels cropped per side
zero model, checkpoint, training, inference, restoration metric, image display, pixel comparison, and protected-data operations

hazy source identity remains the filename stem before the first underscore and exactly ten variants are required per clear scene

intervention.matched_budget: one current SHA-256 pass and one PNG-header metadata pass over exactly 50 clear and 500 hazy files
intervention.primary_variable: bounded symmetric center-crop dimension compatibility of the exact v1 SOTS Indoor pairs
intervention.reference: the archived v1 aggregate file identities, counts, filename pairing, and full RGB PNG decode result

primary_estimand.aggregation: clear scenes for which all ten named hazy variants satisfy the one dataset-wide positive, even, nonnegative and at-most-32-pixels-per-side crop delta, divided by 50

question: For the exact SOTS Indoor files qualified in v1, do all 50 clear scenes and their 500 named hazy variants have one uniform, positive, even, nonnegative clear-minus-hazy dimension delta that supports a symmetric center crop of no more than 32 pixels per side?

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: V1 established exact file identity, counts, pairing, and full RGB PNG decodability, but its equal-dimension gate failed for all 500 pairs and did not record the geometry needed to distinguish a uniform official border crop from heterogeneous or invalid pairing.

decision_design.alias_structure: Not applicable; one explicit evidence-source factor is checked without interactions.

arms.description: The archived v1 counts, pairing, full-decode result, and aggregate file identities.
The current exact-file PNG dimensions and derived center-crop deltas.

estimable_terms: current exact-file geometry equality to the frozen bounded center-crop contract

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: At least one clear scene contains a variant outside the uniform bounded crop contract.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: All ten variants of every clear scene share the one bounded symmetric crop delta.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: All 500 pairs form exactly one positive, even, nonnegative, bounded dimension-delta class.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: At least one invalid pair or more than one dimension-delta class is observed.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: Closed deterministic conjunction: the geometry claim passes only if every predeclared identity, metadata, uniformity, sign, parity, positivity, and crop-bound condition passes.

boundaries.futility: A valid current census with any heterogeneous, negative, odd, zero, or over-limit geometry fails the qualification.
boundaries.precision: Not applicable because the complete finite asset is censused.
boundaries.success: All exact identity and bounded uniform center-crop geometry gates pass.
boundaries.validity: Any v1 evidence, current byte identity, pairing, or PNG metadata failure yields an inconclusive qualification.

design_selection.decision_value: One fixed metadata census directly separates uniform bounded crop geometry from heterogeneous or invalid geometry while preserving the v1 byte identities.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: One CPU-only file-hash and PNG-header pass over the same 550 files.
design_selection.shared_setup: Both hypotheses use the same v1 evidence files, registered root, filename mapping, and one current aggregate-identity pass.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: Hash 550 files, read 550 PNG headers, write two compact JSON files and one completed-unit ledger row, then stop.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: All pairs have the same positive, nonnegative, even clear-minus-hazy width-height delta and each implied per-side crop is at most 32 pixels.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any pair has missing metadata, negative or odd delta, zero delta, excessive crop, or a delta different from another pair.
hypotheses.statement: The 500 v1 dimension mismatches are explained by one bounded symmetric center-crop dimension relationship shared by every named hazy-clear pair.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The metadata census produces multiple delta classes or at least one negative, odd, zero, missing, or over-limit pair geometry.
hypotheses.falsifier: All 500 pairs reproduce one positive, even, nonnegative and bounded clear-minus-hazy delta under the exact v1 file identities.
hypotheses.statement: The v1 mismatch reflects heterogeneous dimensions or an invalid mapping that cannot be represented by one bounded symmetric center crop.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The publication does not prove the byte identity, local directory layout, exact crop delta, or pixel registration of this filesystem copy.
literature_basis.task: RESIDE paired synthetic dehazing benchmark organization
literature_basis.transferable_claim: SOTS Indoor is distributed as paired synthetic hazy and clear benchmark imagery for single-image dehazing evaluation.
